test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He has written a best-selling novel.

options.text: A best-selling novel was being written by him
A best-selling novel has been written by him
A best-selling novel was written by him
A best-selling novel would have been written by him

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The active sentence “He has written a best-selling novel” is in the **present perfect tense** (has written). 
 
• When converting to the passive voice, the **tense **remains the same:
 
• **has written **→** has been written**

So, the correct passive construction is: A best-selling novel has been written by him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Why others are incorrect:

 
• Option 1: was being written → past continuous (wrong tense)
 
• Option 3: was written → simple past (tense changes)
 
• Option 4: would have been written → conditional perfect (changes meaning)

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
